correctness.rationale: Exact orbit-sum covariance, determinant/trace ellipsoid duality and permutation symmetrization reduce the claim to a one-dimensional probability design. The Q(sqrt(5)) quartic factorization is exactly checked. A two-orbit lower benchmark and uniform perturbative loss/variance inequality establish the matching determinant upper bound, thereby forcing both semiaxis limits; contact-layer localization follows from equality in the same strict factorization. Finite tests of 27 covariance cases, n=2,3,4 exact KKT contacts and six benchmark dimensions corroborate but do not substitute for the proof. Risk: the local uniform error estimates require careful independent reading.
